metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Laos on February 3, 2018?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]]
])

laos = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[100.1, 13.9], [107.7, 13.9], [107.7, 22.5], [100.1, 22.5], [100.1, 13.9]]
])

date_start = '2018-02-03'
date_end = '2018-02-04'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Product (FeatureCollection)
fires = ee.FeatureCollection("MODIS/006/MCD14DL").filter(
    ee.Filter.date(date_start, date_end)
)

# Check if data exists
total_fires = fires.size().getInfo()
print(f"Total fire detections on 2018-02-03: {total_fires}")

if total_fires == 0:
    print("No fire data available for this date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Count fires in each country
    fires_cambodia = fires.filterBounds(cambodia)
    fires_laos = fires.filterBounds(laos)
    
    count_cambodia = fires_cambodia.size().getInfo()
    count_laos = fires_laos.size().getInfo()
    
    print(f"Cambodia fire detections: {count_cambodia}")
    print(f"Laos fire detections: {count_laos}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if count_cambodia is None or count_laos is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid counts.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif count_cambodia == 0 and count_laos == 0:
        print("No fires detected in either country.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif count_cambodia > count_laos:
        print("Cambodia had more active fire detections than Laos.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Cambodia did not have more active fire detections than Laos.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.4], [107.6, 10.4], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.4]]
])

laos = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[100.1, 13.9], [107.7, 13.9], [107.7, 22.5], [100.1, 22.5], [100.1, 13.9]]
])

date_start = '2018-02-03'
date_end = '2018-02-04'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try FIRMS dataset
try:
    fires = ee.FeatureCollection("FIRMS").filter(
        ee.Filter.date(date_start, date_end)
    )
    total_fires = fires.size().getInfo()
    print(f"FIRMS: Total fire detections on 2018-02-03: {total_fires}")
    
    if total_fires == 0:
        print("No fire data in FIRMS for this date.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        fires_cambodia = fires.filterBounds(cambodia)
        fires_laos = fires.filterBounds(laos)
        
        count_cambodia = fires_cambodia.size().getInfo()
        count_laos = fires_laos.size().getInfo()
        
        print(f"Cambodia fire detections: {count_cambodia}")
        print(f"Laos fire detections: {count_laos}")
        
        if count_cambodia is None or count_laos is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif count_cambodia == 0 and count_laos == 0:
            print("No fires in either country.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        elif count_cambodia > count_laos:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
            
except Exception as e:
    print(f"FIRMS failed: {e}")
    # Fallback to MOD14A1 (Terra MODIS Fire Product)
    print("Trying MOD14A1 instead...")
    
    mod14 = ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MOD14A1").filter(
        ee.Filter.date(date_start, date_end)
    )
    
    if mod14.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No MOD14A1 data available.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")

        print(f"Laos fire pixels: {count_laos}")

            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
